== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-13-threshold|A Fiend is a creature or entity that has been warped by the Void, placing it outside the natural order. This transformation can occur if an individual survives in the void for too long, as the environment begins to corrupt them and break down their connection to [[Way|the Way]]. Such a process can eventually turn a person into an incomprehensible being that may cease to exist entirely if they cannot find a fragment or iteration to latch onto. [[Fiends]] are categorized by threat levels, such as Class Two, Class Three, or Class Four. While a [[Class Four Fiend]] is considered a threat to cities or low-power civilizations, they can still be resisted by strong mortals. Some [[Fiends]] are powerful enough to contend with [[Judges]]. These entities can manifest in various forms, ranging from demonic figures with horned crowns and crimson eyes to strange shapes like soft centipedes with human hands, or even wooden marionette-like constructs. They are often associated with chaos and can exist in the darkness between stars or within the depths of the void. Communication between [[Fiends]] typically involves a brushing of minds rather than traditional conversation.}}
